rounds.muse_verified_or_corrected: CONFIRMED Robstown founded ~1906 at the junction of the Texas-Mexican and Brownsville & Mexican railroads (Handbook of Texas, TSHA); THC Marker No. 22460 (2019, on E Main Ave near the hotel) confirms the junction formed 1907 when SLB&M connected to Houston. CONFIRMED Tower 197: automatic interlocker at the SLB&M/Tex-Mex crossing in Robstown, connector track lets Laredo traffic go north on UP’s route to Houston, and KCS has trackage rights on UP from Victoria south to Robstown (txrrhistory.com). CONFIRMED freight still active: UP owns the Robstown–Beaumont line and plans 8–12 more trains/day on it (UP filing, Trains.com); KCS is now part of CPKC (CP-KCS merger, Apr 2023); Robstown "remains a railroad hub for UP, BNSF, KCS and Tex-Mex" (Texas HR 2053, 2007). CORRECTED Gemini’s "North-South Union Pacific" framing: the line through Robstown is UP-owned with CPKC/KCS operating via trackage rights, not a CPKC-owned line.
